verdict.rationale: The evidence presents Parsec as a remote-desktop streaming tool. Nothing shows a tablet or spare device acting as an additional display that extends the host desktop. "Virtual monitors" is a bare pricing-page line item with no documentation tying it to this use. "Multi-monitor streaming" streams the host's existing monitors to a client, and Wacom tablet support covers pen input, not using the tablet as a display. These are related features, not the requested capability.

support.subject: As a power user, a tablet or spare device works as an additional display that extends the desktop, not only a mirror of it
